annotator.notes: Student initially treats negative numbers by taking the absolute value of the whole number before summing digits, missing the requirement that only the first digit is signed. Tutor corrects this misconception.

task_context.problem_statement:
def count_nums(arr):
    """
    Write a function count_nums which takes an array of integers and returns
    the number of elements which has a sum of digits > 0.
    If a number is negative, then its first signed digit will be negative:
    e.g. -123 has signed digits -1, 2, and 3.
    >>> count_nums([]) == 0
    >>> count_nums([-1, 11, -11]) == 1
    >>> count_nums([1, 1, 2]) == 3
    """
